claim_quote: The ether premium's point estimate is **119.05 bps**. The **central, commission-only, lower-bound cost is 122.14 bps**. **The premium does not cover the commission.**
evidence_summary: The 122.140 bps total mixes two mutually inconsistent position sizes. The option leg prices ONE straddle (4 fills x $0.20 = 32.571 bps, COSTS.md:83-88); the hedge leg charges ONE WHOLE micro future per resize (8.143 bps each, COSTS.md:91-95) although the registered rule resizes on a +/-0.10 delta move (REGISTRATION.md:289-291) and one MET option is written on one Micro Ether future (venue_table.md:61), so on a one-straddle position each resize is a 0.10-contract order. REGISTRATION.md:208 required the 'minimum order increment' to be recorded; venue_table.md:62 records a minimum PRICE increment instead, and no document anywhere discusses integer-contract hedging. The hedge leg is 73.3% of the deciding total (89.569 of 122.140 bps) and the conclusion flips on a single rebalance: at k=10 cost is 113.997 bps < 119.052. The repo's own stored max_abs_drift_median 0.4067 (BTC) / 0.4167 (ETH) at band 0.1 shows the median path's peak mis-hedge is ~4.1x the stated band, n = 1,955 paths per asset, and this field appears in no document.
recomputation: Script .../work/agentB-vrp-all/gran.py, using the repository's own delta function, daily evaluation, and the untracked raw ETH series (UNANCHORED, read 2026-09-05T03:55:12Z), n = 1,955 paths. ALT A (one straddle, integer futures hedge, H = round(straddle_delta)): hedge trades median 2, p90 5; cost = (4+2)*0.20/245.6205 = 48.856 bps central, (4+5)*0.20/245.6205 = 73.284 bps pessimistic. ETH premium point estimate 119.052 bps exceeds all of 73.284, 48.856 and 41.527, so under every self-consistent position size the premium covers the MET commission. Same model on MBT gives 6.528 / 9.792 bps against the repository's 16.320 / 21.760. What survives: the registered 2.0x HARVESTABLE test still fails on MET under every variant (2*73.284 = 146.568 > CI lower 38.012; 2*45.599 = 91.198 > 38.012), so the VENUE_BLOCKED branch is unaffected.
